name: Dead Channel on the Mainframe
description:
A cracked retro mainframe gateway has gone quiet, but its operators suspect someone left a trace behind. Recover the intruder's encoded proof by examining the gateway's system records and host activity. It runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

---

**Access** — SSH `root@172.20.0.159`, password `stargate-operator-7`

tasks.name: Recover the ghost signal
tasks.description: The cracked mainframe gateway may still hold evidence of an intruder. Recover the encoded proof by examining its system records and host activity. It runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the host's identities with the few roles a quiet gateway should need.
Look for an account whose name or metadata does not fit the ordinary users; account records can carry useful metadata.
Inspect the unusual account's comment field and recognize that its contents are encoded text.
